AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 101 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

Correction to comment 7158347520: #7824 is `audit:partial`, not `audit:completed-later`, because its backup snapshot PR implements the recovery leg only; the upstream write-boundary guard #2173 had already merged before #7824. #7098 later records the combined fixes deployed and acceptance passing.

This slice processed #7819, #7820, #7821, #7822 and #7824:

- #7819 → #3181: `audit:complete`.
- #7820 → #7093: `audit:completed-later` after #7829 fixed the first live apply-run failure and #7093 recorded successful runs.
- #7821 → #7811: `audit:complete`.
- #7822: `audit:no-issue`.
- #7824 → #7098: `audit:partial` (backup/recovery net; the prevention guard was an earlier upstream PR; combined acceptance is recorded on #7098).

The full evidence is in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7819-7824/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7819-7824.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 101 valid PRs audited from 105 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 145 identifiers remain, next #7826. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
